summary: You can bring real heat and confidence to love when you use it. The chemistry and the nerve are there, available when you reach for them. They reward you for showing up.
body: You can bring real heat and confidence to love when you use it. The chemistry and the nerve are there, available when you reach for them. They reward you for showing up. Left idle, you might wait to be chosen or keep desire polite. But when you let yourself want out loud and act on it, things spark to life. The opening pays out when you take it. Reach for it and you stop waiting for permission to want.
gift: At your best: warm and bold once you decide to show up.
shadow: The trap: keeping desire polite and waiting to be chosen.
integration: Let love and values and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
do: Bring the heat instead of waiting for it
